Send Feedback

Report bugs or suggest features

Have a bug report or feature suggestion? Let me know—your feedback helps improve FDNY Mutual Tracker for all users.

Privacy: Your feedback is submitted through formsubmit.co and sent to fdnyscheduler@gmail.com. We use your email only to respond to your feedback. Your data is not shared or used for any other purpose. Please review formsubmit.co's privacy policy for details on how they handle data.

Privacy First. All your calendar data is backed up using your personal iCloud Drive or Google Drive. This data is encrypted and accessible only to you; we do not have access to it, and it is never shared. The only exception is the "My Crew" mutual swap feature. When both parties agree to a swap, we share your name, company, and optional phone number to ensure a smooth and reliable exchange. Your data is never used for any other purpose.
